# mux.js 6.3.0

`mux-mp4.min.js` is the official MP4 build from https://registry.npmjs.org/mux.js/-/mux.js-6.3.0.tgz. The package SHA-512 integrity was verified against the npm registry. Source: https://github.com/videojs/mux.js.

Used to remux MPEG-TS HLS into fragmented MP4 without re-encoding. Distributed under Apache-2.0; see `mux-LICENSE`. The build is bundled into the userscript, with no runtime CDN dependency.
